node.title: HGE4 multiscale Haar norm product and m=64 exact-level close
node.closure: proof plus exhaustive quarter-orbit endpoint verifier
node.statement: All dyadic even-moment norms share one exact Haar-energy budget; structural zero scales contribute explicit powers of two to every remaining norm. The resulting norm product, together with a sharp 28,171-state endpoint lemma, proves E_h^prim(64,p)=0 for every h>=4 on every official ambient row. Thus the complete m=64 exact level has zero debit and surviving HGE4 levels begin at m=128. No higher-level aggregate is claimed.
